_why: Stack 3 of 4 (ruling 2026-08-08-inference-proxy-is-a-rules-stack): 'a 3rd stack for the provider/model combinations and what the specifics are.' A combo is the routable unit: the nest sieves THESE rows, and a request routes only through a combo naming its provider and its model. Failover walks combos of the SAME requested model on other providers, cheapest surviving provider first — the resolver never substitutes a model on its own (the cache canonicalizes on the request, and an answer from a different model is a different answer).
